pages.text: Config screen → Visuals → $(bold)eyedropper$(): opens a preview of your skin; click one pixel to use that color for the lower body while sitting.$(br2)A default color is also sampled automatically the first time you sit down; change it manually anytime.

$(bold)Priority$(): the broadcast color (from other players, or from yourself while sitting) wins over the local config.$(br2)After changing the color, both you and other players see the updated sitting lower body.
